about.heading: How to play 1v1 Minesweeper
about.intro: 1v1 Minesweeper turns the classic single-player puzzle into a head-to-head race. Instead of a random minefield, each player hides mines on their own board — then you both race to clear your opponent's board first. It's free, runs in any browser on desktop or phone, and needs no account or download.
how: Create a private game and send the link to a friend, jump into a random match, or practise against the AI.
Classic mode: place your mines, then clear your opponent's board. Numbers show how many mines touch each square — flag the mines and reveal everything else without hitting one.
Rush mode: race through small random boards with 3 lives. A mine costs a life and skips the board; clear more boards than your opponent before time runs out.
Every finished match adds a win or loss to your nickname on the global leaderboard.

faq.a: Yes. It's completely free and runs in your browser — no sign-up, no download.

faq.q: Can I play Minesweeper online with a friend?
faq.a: Yes. Create a private game and share the link; your friend joins instantly and you play live, head to head.

faq.q: Can I play against the computer?
faq.a: Yes. Play vs AI has Easy, Medium and Hard opponents, so you can practise before taking on real players.

faq.q: What's the difference between Classic and Rush?
faq.a: Classic is one board whose mines your opponent placed. Rush is a timed race through many small random boards with 3 lives.
Enter a nickname before you play. Each finished multiplayer match records a win or loss for that name on the global leaderboard.
